controls: Generated local CA and synthetic-invalid credential only.
Minimal constructed child environment; no inherited provider credentials, proxy environment, user site or user debugger startup.

No forced garbage collection, arbitrary sleep or manual runtime shutdown.
No OS trust/core-pattern changes and no repository/shared target/installed package changes.
disposition: Non-reproduction only. Original SIGSEGV remains unexplained and its reliability gate remains open; no fix or immunity established.
limits: Debugger, explicit markers, isolated wheel path and minimal child environment differ from the original failing full binding suite and may alter timing.
